AiAssistantScreen.title: AI assistant
AiAssistantScreen.description: Use the AI assistant you already have (Claude, ChatGPT or another) inside TManage. It can search, read your work, create tasks and comment, always with your permissions and nothing more.
AiAssistantScreen.step1Body: A key lets your assistant sign in to TManage as you. It can only do what you can do, and you can switch it off at any time.
AiAssistantScreen.step2Body: Copy the settings below into Claude, ChatGPT or any assistant that supports MCP connectors.
AiAssistantScreen.step3Body: For example: “What is overdue for me this week?” or “Create a task to review the homepage copy.”
AiAssistantScreen.noChargeNote: TManage does not charge for AI and does not send your work to an AI company. Your own assistant does the thinking, under your own account with that company.
AiAssistantScreen.keyFilledNote: When you create a key, it is filled in here for you.

AiAssistantScreen.statusDetailWaiting: You have a key, but no assistant has used it yet.

AiAssistantScreen.createKeyError: We could not create the key
AiAssistantScreen.keyCreatedBody: This is the only time the key is shown. It is already filled in the connection settings. If you lose it, switch it off and create a new one.
AiAssistantScreen.revokeKeyError: We could not revoke that key
AiAssistantScreen.revokeNotePrefix: Revoking a key disconnects the assistant using it straight away. All your keys, including revoked ones, are listed under

AiAssistantScreen.cdStep2: Paste the settings below, save, and restart Claude Desktop. They connect Claude to your TManage address with your key.
AiAssistantScreen.cdStep3: The TManage tools appear under the tools icon in a new chat.
AiAssistantScreen.ccStep1: Run this once in a terminal. Claude Code then has the TManage tools.
AiAssistantScreen.cgStep1Prefix: ChatGPT connects to your TManage address:
AiAssistantScreen.cgStep2: In ChatGPT open Settings, then Connectors, turn on developer mode and add a connector with that address.
AiAssistantScreen.cgStep3: When ChatGPT asks how to sign in, give it your key as a bearer token.
